description: Does a version satisfy an npm-style range (^, ~, x-ranges, hyphen ranges, comparators, || alternatives)? Returns the answer and the range desugared into plain comparators (e.g. ^0.2.3 → >=0.2.3 <0.3.0-0), with a note when npm's prerelease rule is why it fails. Read-only. Same engine as GET /api/satisfies.

includePrerelease.description: Let prereleases match any range they fall inside (npm includePrerelease). Default false (npm behaviour).

version.description: Version to test: a semantic version such as "1.4.2", "v2.0.0" or "3.0.0-rc.1+build.5".

name: check_range
title: Check a version against an npm range
